newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-WHOLESALE, RETAIL SALES RISE YR/YR IN FEB.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-WHOLESALE, RETAIL SALES RISE YR/YR IN FEB.

text.p: Estonia's wholesale sales increased 19 percent and retail sales were up by 11 percent in February compared to the same month in 1996, the statistics office said on Thursday.
Compared to January, wholesales decreased by three percent, the statistics office said in a statement.
Wholesales totalled 3.3 billion kroons in February and 6.78 billion kroons in the first two months.
Although total retail sales increased by 11 percent, retail sales of food products decreased by eight percent in February.
Retail sales totalled 1.3 billion kroons in February and 2.7 billion kroons in the first two months of the year.
